entities.name: Tania Cayce
entities.description: White-haired potion-maker's apprentice in post-invasion Dominaria.

entities.name: Donner Rus
entities.description: Stern, vain potion-master, Tania's master, incinerated by the dragon.

entities.name: Vaan
entities.description: Pixie under a geas who seeks to kill the dragon that enslaved his people.

entities.name: Kula
entities.description: Druid who healed Tania and forced her along.

entities.name: Mak Fawa
entities.description: Mechanical dragon merged with the skeleton of Zumaki.

entities.name: Zumaki of the Bottomless Pool
entities.description: Dragon whose skeleton is linked to the Mak Fawa.

entities.name: Captain Hask
entities.description: Used the Hand of Righteous Retribution against the dragon.

entities.name: Hand of Righteous Retribution
entities.description: Magical sword Tania used against the dragon.

events.summary: Vaan approaches Rus for help killing the dragon; Rus pretends to accept and Tania deduces Vaan is under a geas.
events.quote: it was Tania who figured out that the morose Vaan was hiding something

events.summary: Rus drugs the group and sends Tania into the lair; the dragon is a Mak Fawa, Vaan saves Tania, and Rus is incinerated.
Kula heals Tania and forces her to join the fight; the group cannot defeat the dragon.
events.quote: The group fought hard but could not defeat the dragon.

events.summary: The dying Vaan reveals the dragon is a merger of the Mak Fawa and Zumaki.
events.quote: the geas that was placed on him slipped

events.summary: Tania wields the Hand of Righteous Retribution and seemingly destroys the dragon and the skeleton, but is knocked unconscious.
events.quote: she seemingly managed to destroy the dragon and the skeleton

events.summary: Tania wakes carried by Kula and declines to become her apprentice.
events.quote: Tania decided that she was not looking for a new master

relations.quote: She was the apprentice of potion-master Donner Rus
